source_cn:
<HighLight>致迷途的羔羊与渴求庇护的灵魂</>：
能占用一下您的时间吗？我想给您讲一讲我们的道标和救主，“愚者”先生。
我主自称愚者，在过去，在现在，也在未来，他是支配灵界的伟大主宰，也是执掌好运的黄黑之王，更是每个生灵追求永恒的道标。
他是怜悯的，他是仁慈的，他是这个世界的救主，他让我们以他来代称，而非祂。
他的仁爱播撒在人间，为家家户户带去温暖。我们将这关怀化作触手可及的回馈，将愚者的福音传遍大地——
每月购买愚者福音，您将获得每日返现，以及福音定期馈赠的材料物资。我们还将为您带来每日福音券的抽取，解读运势。
聆听《愚者圣典》，赞美愚者！赞美愚者的馈赠！愿我主的恩典在您身边日夜相伴，愿这福音成为您前行路上永不熄灭的灯火！
ref_en:
<HighLight>To the lost lambs and souls seeking shelter</>: 
May I have a moment of your time? I would like to tell you about our beacon and savior, Mr. Fool. 
My Lord calls himself The Fool. In the past, in the present, and in the future, He is the great ruler who dominates the Spirit World, the King of Yellow and Black who holds good luck, and the beacon for every living creature pursuing eternity. 
He is compassionate, He is merciful, and He is the savior of this world. He lets us refer to Him as 'him' instead of 'He'. 
His benevolence is spread across the human world, bringing warmth to every household. We transform this care into tangible rewards, spreading the Gospel of The Fool throughout the land—
Purchase the Gospel of The Fool every month to receive daily cashbacks, as well as materials and supplies gifted regularly by the Gospel. We will also bring you daily Gospel Ticket draws and fortune readings. 
Listen to the 'Scripture of The Fool', praise The Fool! Praise the gifts of The Fool! May the grace of my Lord accompany you day and night, and may this Gospel become the never-extinguishing lamp on your path forward!

source_cn: 伯德温·威瑟尔以非凡者身份征战背誓之战，载誉而归。临终前，他将自己的非凡特性融入铠甲，赋予它“坚强不屈的灵魂”，为它取名伊桑。此后六百年，伊桑守护着威瑟尔家族，只需一句古赫密斯语便能拔剑出鞘。直到庄园遇袭之夜，它被未知污染侵蚀，机械地执行命令，屠尽了庄园内每一个活人。\n“为了家族的荣耀！”
ref_en: Baldwin Wetherell fought in the War of Broken Oaths as a Beyonder and returned with honors. Before his death, he fused his Beyonder characteristic into his armor, endowing it with a 'strong and unyielding soul,' and named it Ethan. For the next six hundred years, Ethan guarded the Wetherell family, requiring only a single phrase in ancient Hermes to draw its sword. Until the night the manor was attacked, it was eroded by unknown corruption, mechanically executing orders and slaughtering every living person in the manor. \n "For the glory of the family!"

source_cn:
我要输了。但我仍然认为数字远比文字更为深奥、迷人。

蒙特不认同。所以我们各自打开一本隐秘的书，冒着死去或变成木偶的风险，从这两件封印物中寻找证明。

不幸读到这里的人——你可能和我有着相同的命运。这本书吞噬了数字和信息。而<InvHighlight>三个水晶球是再次封印它的唯一方式 </>。三，几何学里最小的封闭结构。在数字本身被隐去后，你所能依靠的只有数字之间的关系，这是你唯一的希望。

请记住：<InvHighlight>α等于“失序之书”书名的字数 </>，是第一个内藏关系的数字，在它之前的数字都是不可被分割的整体。

<InvHighlight> α</>等于<InvHighlight>4</> 
<InvHighlight> β</>等于<InvHighlight>？</> 
<InvHighlight> ω</>等于<InvHighlight>？</>
ref_en:
I am going to lose. But I still think numbers are far more profound and fascinating than words. 
 
 Monte disagrees. So we each opened a secret book, risking death or becoming a puppet, to look for proof from these two Sealed Artifacts. 
 
 Those who unfortunately read this far—you might have the same fate as me. This book devours numbers and information. And <InvHighlight> three crystal balls are the only way to seal it again </>. Three, the smallest closed structure in geometry. After the numbers themselves are hidden, all you can rely on is the relationship between the numbers; this is your only hope. 
 
 Please remember: <InvHighlight> α equals the number of characters in the title of the "Book of Disorder" </>, which is the first number containing an internal relationship; the numbers before it are all indivisible wholes. 
 
 <InvHighlight> α </> equals <InvHighlight> 4 </> 
 <InvHighlight> β </> equals <InvHighlight> ? </> 
 <InvHighlight> ω </> equals <InvHighlight> ? </>

ref_en: Mode Introduction </> In the Moment of Fate battlefield, Beyonders are divided into two factions. Each match lasts <Highlight> 4 minutes </>. The side with the higher score at the end wins. If scores are tied, the number of kills and then damage dealt are compared; the higher side wins. If all are tied, a random side wins. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Mechanism Explanation </> <Highlight> Score Acquisition: </> Can be obtained by picking up buff orbs, kills, assists, and entering the Vortex of Strife to compete. <Highlight> Anchor Convergence: </> Anchor points will appear in the match and last for <Highlight> 15 seconds </>. Based on the <Highlight> required number of people </>, enter the anchor point. Once the requirement is met and held for <Highlight> 3 seconds </>, Beyonders of that faction will be assembled there, and participating Beyonders will receive a temporary attribute bonus. <Highlight> Vortex of Strife: </> A Vortex of Strife will appear in the middle of the battlefield. When the <Highlight> countdown ends </>, Beyonders remaining in the vortex will split the points equally. <Highlight> Buff Orbs: </> Buff orbs will appear on the battlefield; picking them up grants <Highlight> points and attribute bonuses </>. <Highlight> Fate Mushrooms: </> In the Moment of Fate battlefield, Beyonders will drop Fate Mushrooms after dying three consecutive times: allies drop green Fate Mushrooms with Abundance power, which restore health when picked up; enemies drop red Fate Mushrooms with Destruction power, which deduct health when picked up. Please distinguish carefully before picking them up.

%s:
      我听闻你与子嗣守护遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对子嗣守护的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302121">子嗣守护的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard you had a bitter struggle with the Offspring Protection. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of the past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the trick to facing the Offspring Protection: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302121">Record of Offspring Protection</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what often makes people stop is not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing more new adventures. I think next time, what I hear will be better news. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me, which might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

source_cn:
“巫王”卡拉曼从玫瑰学派接过这个人偶时，它的眼眶还是空的。
“记住，”交付者警告，“用你的血肉喂它。别让它长出眼睛。”
卡拉曼不以为意。一个巴掌大的玩具能有多危险？
人偶确实很好用——它能让死物复活，让神奇物品听命，甚至瞬移逃生。卡拉曼赢得了无数场战斗，名声鹊起。
但有一天，他忘记喂养了。
第二天，人偶的左眼眶长出了一颗玻璃珠般的眼球。
卡拉曼慌忙切下手指，用鲜血涂抹，眼球消退了。但从那以后，他每晚都梦见那个人偶——它坐在床边，空洞的眼眶直视着他，十指连按，像在弹奏丧歌。
后来克莱恩击杀了卡拉曼，人偶作为战利品落入他手。
当克莱恩用“母神之血”进行“友好协商”时，人偶的十指剧烈颤抖，比起像是终于遇见了可以谈判的对手，更像是看见了不可名状的恐惧。
从那以后，它安分了。但那两个黑洞，仍在等待主人失误的那一天。
ref_en:
When 'Witch King' Karaman accepted this doll from the Rose School of Thought, its eye sockets were still empty. 
 'Remember,' the deliverer warned, 'feed it with your flesh and blood. Don't let it grow eyes.' 
 Karaman didn't care. How dangerous could a palm-sized toy be? 
 The doll was indeed very useful—it could resurrect dead objects, make mystical items obey, and even teleport to escape. Karaman won countless battles and became famous. 
 But one day, he forgot to feed it. 
 The next day, a glass-bead-like eyeball grew in the doll's left eye socket. 
 Karaman hurriedly cut his finger and smeared it with blood, and the eyeball receded. But from then on, he dreamed of that doll every night—it sat by the bed, its hollow eye sockets staring straight at him, its ten fingers pressing, as if playing a funeral song. 
 Later, Klein killed Karaman, and the doll fell into his hands as a trophy. 
 When Klein used the 'Blood of the Mother' for 'friendly negotiation', the doll's ten fingers trembled violently; it looked more like it had seen an indescribable horror than finally meeting an opponent it could negotiate with. 
 Since then, it has behaved itself. But those two black holes are still waiting for the day its master makes a mistake.

source_cn:
邓恩停顿了一下，微笑打量了克莱恩的衣着几眼，意味深长道：
“而且你也需要一根手杖，并且得重新买正装了。”
克莱恩怔了一秒，旋即醒悟，脸上顿时有点发烧，因为自己穿的这套是廉价品。
正常而言，礼帽得是丝绸制成的，价值5到6苏勒，领结3苏勒，镶银的手杖7到8苏勒，衬衫3苏勒，裤子、马甲和燕尾正装得7镑左右，皮靴9到10苏勒，这么一套下来，总计得8镑7苏勒以上，当然，一位体面的绅士还需要表链、怀表和皮夹。
当初原主和哥哥班森省吃俭用，攒了一笔钱，去衣帽店问了一下，结果连价都不敢还就灰溜溜走了，在铁十字街附近的廉价商店里凑合着每人买了一套，一共还不到两镑。
就是因为这件事情，原主对衣物价格的印象深刻到极点。
“好，好的。”克莱恩略有结巴地回答。
他和原主一样，也是个要脸的人。
ref_en:
Dunn paused, smiled, and looked at Klein's attire for a few moments, then said meaningfully: 
"And you also need a cane, and you'll have to buy a formal suit again." 
Klein froze for a second, then immediately realized, his face burning instantly, because the suit he was wearing was a cheap one. 
Normally, a top hat should be made of silk, worth 5 to 6 soli, a bow tie 3 soli, a silver-inlaid cane 7 to 8 soli, a shirt 3 soli, trousers, a vest, and a tailcoat suit about 7 pounds, leather boots 9 to 10 soli. A set like this would cost a total of over 8 pounds and 7 soli. Of course, a decent gentleman also needs a watch chain, a pocket watch, and a leather wallet. 
Back then, the original owner and his brother Benson saved every penny, gathered a sum of money, and went to a clothing store to ask. As a result, they didn't even dare to haggle and left dejectedly. They settled for buying a set each at a cheap store near Iron Cross Street, which cost less than two pounds in total. 
It was because of this incident that the original owner had an extremely deep impression of the price of clothing. 
"Okay, okay," Klein replied, stuttering slightly. 
Like the original owner, he was also a person who cared about his dignity.

source_cn: （一）\n　　我们是5月23日上午上山的，上山的时候碰到了一个穿着整齐西装的男人，四十来岁的样子，他向我们询问下山的路，给我感觉像城堡里的伯爵先生一样，佐治将下山的路告诉给他。没走两步，我回头，他消失不见了。\n　　佐治说要学习搭帐篷，我给他示范了三次，最后反倒是我被帐篷难倒了，这新买的帐篷不太顶用。
ref_en: (I)\n　　We went up the mountain on the morning of May 23rd. On the way up, we met a man in a neat suit, looking to be in his forties. He asked us for the way down the mountain. He gave me the feeling of a Count in a castle. George told him the way down. We hadn't walked two steps when I turned back, and he had disappeared.\n　　George said he wanted to learn how to set up a tent. I demonstrated it to him three times, but in the end, I was the one stumped by the tent. This newly bought tent isn't very reliable.

ref_en: Just finished attending the "Hero of Tingen" commendation ceremony, and my mood is still a bit excited. With this honor, it seems that my superiors will soon nominate me as the next police chief. I also need to promote some capable people below me. \n That hot-headed kid is not bad; his strength is very strong, it's just that his mouth is a bit foul, and he keeps "damn it" on his lips all day, but overall he is still very much to my liking. \n Just catching people is not enough. 听，这是因蒂斯民众的呼声！执政官罗塞尔·古斯塔夫，我喜欢这个称呼。
        在这场与索伦家族的博弈中，我险胜一筹。但他们不愧是从第四纪存续至今的古老家族，底蕴和积累深厚得可怕。要不是因蒂斯深陷纷乱已久，民众的不满日益滋长，我根本无法点燃暴乱的火星，站到现在的位置上。
        接下来，就是逐步推行那些我构思已久的政策。当然，首先是——
        旧城区真是太脏了！爱国卫生行动必须尽快推广，首都下水道和公共厕所也要尽快改善。所有居民都要烧水喝、勤洗手，不许乱扔垃圾和随地大小便！
        顺便，每个人都要接受义务教育，都要接受招生考试的毒打！每一个！
        我要打造一个干净温馨、整洁明亮，处处是诗歌，家家有花草的首都特里尔。
        但永恒烈阳教会那群家伙是傻子吗？
        我保护贸易与推行新法的目的之一，就是为了与他们和解啊！和气生财的道理懂不懂？要追究谋权篡位的事到什么时候，他们果然是被太阳烤坏了脑袋——该死，有点想念故乡的烤脑花了。
ref_en:
Listen, this is the voice of the Intis people! Consul Roselle Gustav, I like this title. 
 In this game of chess against the Sauron family, I won by a narrow margin. But they truly deserve to be an ancient family that has survived since the Fourth Epoch; their foundation and accumulation are terrifyingly deep. If it weren't for the fact that Intis had been mired in chaos for so long and the people's dissatisfaction was growing daily, I would never have been able to ignite the sparks of rebellion and stand where I am today. 
 Next, it is time to gradually implement the policies I have been conceiving for a long time. Of course, first is— 
 The old city district is just too dirty! The patriotic health campaign must be promoted as soon as possible, and the capital's sewers and public toilets must be improved quickly. All residents must boil water to drink, wash their hands frequently, and are forbidden from littering or urinating and defecating in public! 
 By the way, everyone must receive compulsory education and suffer the torture of entrance exams! Everyone! 
 I want to build a clean, cozy, tidy, and bright capital of Trier, where poetry is everywhere and every home has flowers and plants. 
 But are those guys in the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun idiots? 
 One of my purposes for protecting trade and promoting new laws was to reconcile with them! Don't they understand the principle that harmony brings wealth? How long are they going to pursue the matter of usurping power? They must have had their brains baked by the sun—damn it, I kind of miss the grilled brains from my hometown.

source_cn:
夏尔，算算时间他应该已经去世了。死亡是一份礼物，希望他能作为普通人去度过幸福的一生。这是我们其他所有人都无法获得的平静……
        博诺瓦……该死的蒸汽与机械之神，别让我逮到你！还有查拉图和“门”，等我复活了，我绝对一个个上门好好拜访！我的孩子应当肆意自由地活着，而不是成为神明的傀儡！不知道他那纯粹的神性中，有没有那么一点对我这个父亲的爱……一点点就够了。
        心爱的贝尔纳黛，应验了查拉图的预言，她终究憎恨、厌弃和离开了我。不知道我被刺杀后她怎么样了……
        头开始疼了，那家伙的呓语声真是难听。我又得睡了，我不会将这份污染带到这个世界上，这里还有我想守护的东西。哈哈，就跟我一起被封印在这里吧！
        但我终会归来，只要我的子民还在信仰我，只要我留下的文明与规则没有消逝，只要这个世界还有人记得我的名字……连归来的口号我都想好了——因蒂斯的子民们，你们的皇帝回来了！
        但在又一次的沉眠前，我似乎看到了一些被我遗忘了许久的东西……炸鸡、可乐、游戏机、家，和好像老去了一些的爸妈……
        那是或许平凡乏味但再也回不去的人生。
        故乡啊……
ref_en:
Charles, calculating the time, he should have passed away by now. Death is a gift; I hope he can spend a happy life as an ordinary person. This is a peace that none of the rest of us can ever obtain...
        Bernadette... damn you, God of Steam and Machinery, don't let me catch you! And Zarathul and the "Door," once I am resurrected, I will definitely visit you one by one! My child should live freely and wantonly, not become a puppet of the gods! I wonder if there is even a tiny bit of love for me, her father, in that pure divinity of hers... just a little bit would be enough.
        My beloved Bernadette, Zarathul's prophecy has come true; she eventually hated, abandoned, and left me. I wonder how she is doing after I was assassinated...
        My head is starting to ache; that guy's babbling is truly unpleasant. I have to sleep again. I will not bring this corruption into this world; there are still things here I want to protect. Haha, just be sealed here with me!
        But I will eventually return, as long as my people still believe in me, as long as the civilization and rules I left behind have not faded, as long as there is still someone in this world who remembers my name... I have even thought of the slogan for my return—People of Intis, your Emperor has returned!
        But before falling into another slumber, I seem to have seen some things I had forgotten for a long time... fried chicken, cola, game consoles, home, and my parents who seem to have aged a bit...
        That is a life that might have been ordinary and dull, but one I can never return to.
        My homeland...

ref_en: <InvDefault_HW>"Let's go!" Daly jumped to the top of the antlers, "Even if you get lost inside, my singing can lead us on the right path."</>\n\n　　<InvDefault_HW>They entered the cave just like that. The structure inside was intricate and complex, and it took Dunn and Daly quite a bit of effort to find the injured bat family. Just as they were preparing to leave the cave, a gale blew outside, and countless snowflakes were carried by the wind, blocking all light. Dunn tried several more directions. More desperate than not finding the exit was the increasingly weak breathing of the bat family.</>

ref_en: In the factory district, you hear the drunkard Rex scolding the chimney sweep boy, Dodge. You step in to stop him and learn that Dodge's brother, Jem, is hospitalized with a serious illness, and he desperately needs today's wages for treatment. You assist Dodge in finishing his work, but the employer lights a fire to rush him, and Dodge nearly dies in the thick smoke. You extinguish the fire and save Dodge, but Rex still withholds his pay, claiming he 'didn't sweep it clean'. Dodge finally sees Rex's true face and leaves with you. Heartless bosses will never stop exploiting, and countless other Dodges are struggling to survive in the factory smoke.

source_cn:
贝尔纳黛·古斯塔夫，罗塞尔·古斯塔夫的长女，前因蒂斯皇女，最受罗塞尔宠爱的孩子。
        她诞生于罗塞尔执政前，在罗塞尔执政时站在父亲的身侧共沐荣光，却在罗塞尔成为大帝后离开因蒂斯。
        没有人知道这位皇女去了哪里，宫廷里的人说在“那段时间”，他们经常听到大帝与皇女争吵的声音。也有人说罗塞尔预言了自己的死亡，早早地让自己最心爱的女儿离开，不要被纷争波及。
        喧嚣并未随着大帝的陨落而沉默，反而随着时间的流逝而成为历史、传奇或传记中的一部分。在这些真真假假的传说中，有人说曾在大海上见过神似贝尔纳黛·古斯塔夫的人，而她要去往的方向似乎指向了狂暴海。
        那人说得笃定，自称祖先曾是罗塞尔大帝的宫廷侍从，家中珍藏皇女油画像一幅，绝不会认错，下一秒却因为醉酒又欠钱跟人打成一团。
        而此时，距罗塞尔大帝的陨落已经过去了一百五十四年。
ref_en:
Bernadette Gustav, the eldest daughter of Roselle Gustav, former Intis Princess, and the child most favored by Roselle. 
 She was born before Roselle took power and stood by her father's side to share in the glory during his reign, yet she left Intis after Roselle became Emperor. 
 No one knows where this princess went. People in the palace said that during "that period," they often heard the sounds of arguments between the Emperor and the Princess. Others said that Roselle had foreseen his own death and had his most beloved daughter leave early so she would not be caught up in the conflict. 
 The clamor did not fall silent with the Emperor's fall; instead, as time passed, it became a part of history, legends, or biographies. Among these true and false tales, some say they have seen someone resembling Bernadette Gustav on the high seas, and the direction she was heading seemed to point toward the Berserk Sea. 
 That person spoke with certainty, claiming their ancestor was a court attendant to Emperor Roselle and that a portrait of the Princess was treasured in their home, insisting they could never be mistaken, only to get into a brawl with others the next second due to being drunk and in debt. 
 At this time, one hundred and fifty-four years had passed since the fall of Emperor Roselle.

ref_en: <Italic>—You begin to hear some unspeakable whispers; they are like fragments of speech leaking from the depths of your consciousness, directionless and meaningless, yet impossible to ignore. But you dare not be certain that the next time, and the time after that, the world will reset as usual.</>

<P_Yellow>日期</> 1354年7月

<P_Yellow>事件概述</>
自1354年6月起，廷根市接连发生多起市民离奇失踪案件。经黑荆棘安保公司介入调查，确认事件背后存在隐秘的非凡力量干预，最终证实为邪神组织“月亮仆从”策划的大规模献祭仪式，其目标是借助知识皇冠与绝望魔镜，将整座城市献祭于“伟大母亲”（经确认，实为▇▇▇▇的化身），以诞育邪神子嗣。

<P_Yellow>失踪案详情</>
失踪者多为廷根普通市民，涵盖各个阶层：工人、富商、学生等。
多数失踪者近期接触过罗塞尔大帝相关物品，包括戏剧节铜镜、海报、宣传品。
部分失踪者在失踪前曾参与五月庄园的高薪短工招募。

<P_Yellow> Security Level </> Confidential 
<P_Yellow> Reporter </> Leonard Mitchell 
<P_Yellow> Date </> July 1354 

<P_Yellow> Event Overview </>
 Since June 1354, a series of bizarre disappearance cases of citizens have occurred in Tingen. After the Blackthorn Security Company intervened in the investigation, it was confirmed that there was hidden Beyonder power intervention behind the events, and it was finally confirmed to be a large-scale Sacrifice Ritual planned by the evil god organization "Moon Servant." Its goal was to use the Crown of Knowledge and the Magic Mirror of Despair to sacrifice the entire city to the "Great Mother" (confirmed to be the avatar of ▇▇▇▇) to give birth to the evil god's offspring.

<P_Yellow> Details of Disappearance Cases </>
 Most of the missing persons were ordinary Tingen citizens, covering all walks of life: workers, wealthy merchants, students, etc. 
 Most of the missing persons had recently come into contact with items related to Emperor Roselle, including drama festival mirrors, posters, and promotional materials. 
 Some of the missing persons had participated in the high-paying short-term job recruitment at May Manor before going missing.

source_cn:
感谢你对托马斯一事的调查，我们也查明了他的来历。
      他曾是鲁恩皇家军团成员，在南大陆作战时获得非凡特性，成为非凡者。回到鲁恩后，成为了黑夜教会的牧师，凭借教会的资源，一步步晋升为序列6“死灵导师”。
      我们从他旧日同僚处得知，他在战场上负责伤亡登记，经手过大量死亡通知。退役后，长期被噩梦困扰。灵教团正是抓住了这一点，以“永暗蜡烛”为饵，许诺他从恐惧中解脱，最终将他变成了棋子。

      此事背后，灵教团的影子已清晰可见。如果今后遇到与此相关的线索，请务必告知我。
ref_en:
Thank you for your investigation into the Thomas matter; we have also ascertained his origins. 
      He was once a member of the Loen Royal Army and obtained a Beyonder characteristic while fighting in the Southern Continent, becoming a Beyonder. After returning to Loen, he became a priest of the Church of the Night. Relying on the Church's resources, he advanced step by step to Sequence 6 "Necromancer." 
      We learned from his former colleagues that he was responsible for casualty registration on the battlefield and handled a large number of death notifications. After retiring, he was long plagued by nightmares. The Rose School of Thought seized upon this, using the "Candle of Eternal Darkness" as bait, promising him relief from his horror, and ultimately turned him into a pawn. 

      Behind this matter, the shadow of the Rose School of Thought is already clearly visible. If you encounter any clues related to this in the future, please be sure to inform me.

source_cn:
我和几个学员从昨晚开始就在收拾东西，很快就能离开这诡异的地方了。
昨晚，有两位研究员先生消失了，还有几个人因为害怕而跑出了营地，我认为这并不是理智的选择，因为野外的环境更加恶劣。
我能看得出来曼斯教授也十分不安，但他是我们一行人的主心骨。他今天看起来是强撑着下达的指示，毕竟对于人类而言——未知是最古老最强烈的恐惧，就连曼斯教授也不例外。
稍后，我们将消耗一部分带来的食物（这将减少我们行李的重量），然后我们就会启程。

我决定一路记录下目前所见的一切，因为就在刚才，我看见一个活生生的人，从我眼前消失。我已经做好最坏的打算，或许这本日记将是我留在这个世界上的最后一抹痕迹。

一旁的学员转过头对我说，曼斯教授也不见了，下一个会（日记戛然而止）
ref_en:
My fellow students and I have been packing since last night, and we will soon be able to leave this eerie place.
Last night, two researchers disappeared, and several others ran out of the camp out of fear. I do not consider this a rational choice, as the environment in the wild is even harsher.
I can tell that Professor Mans is also very uneasy, but he is the backbone of our group. He seemed to be forcing himself to issue instructions today. After all, for humans—the unknown is the oldest and most intense horror, and Professor Mans is no exception.
Shortly, we will consume a portion of the food we brought (which will reduce the weight of our luggage), and then we will set off.

I have decided to record everything I see along the way, because just a moment ago, I saw a living person disappear right before my eyes. I have prepared for the worst; perhaps this diary will be the last trace I leave in this world.

A student beside me turned and said to me that Professor Mans is also gone, and the next one will be (the diary ends abruptly)

source_cn:
日安！
　　金秋湖最近越发热了，不知道您身体怎么样？如果您需要，可以托梦给我，我有最好的解暑茶。
　　我最近很好。个头长高了一点，草药书看到了第六章，成功配出了咳嗽药剂，治好了汉娜婶婶的感冒。
　　接下来我要开始练习更高级的药方。如果您不太忙的话，我想要几棵水刃草，用来做醒神药剂。因为没学会游泳，我一直没拿到它。
　　如果您太忙也没关系！我会努力练习游泳的。
ref_en:
Good day!
	Golden Autumn Lake has been getting hotter lately; I wonder how your health is? If you need to, you can send me a dream; I have the best tea for cooling off.
	I am doing very well recently. I have grown a little taller, read to the sixth chapter of the Herbs book, and successfully concocted a cough potion that cured Aunt Hannah's cold.
	Next, I am going to start practicing more advanced prescriptions. If you are not too busy, I would like a few stalks of Water Blade Grass to make a refreshing potion. Because I haven't learned to swim, I haven't been able to get it.
	If you are too busy, that's okay too! I will work hard on practicing swimming.

source_cn:
奥黛丽缓缓吐了口气，绽放出优雅明丽的笑容，在父亲和母亲的陪伴下，走出休息室，进入晚会大厅。
　　她一路走上最前方的高台，在一道道惊艳的目光里，将戴着及肘白纱手套的手递给了王后。
　　王后牵着她，走向高台边缘，面对所有宾客。稍有停顿，王后微笑道：
　　“虽然这是贝克兰德历史上的黑暗时段，但我们依然有一颗足以照亮整座城市的宝石，她的智慧，她的美貌，她的品格，她的礼仪，都无可挑剔。
　　“今天，我将她正式介绍给你们。
　　“奥黛丽·霍尔小姐。”
　　砰！砰！砰！
　　落地窗外，烟花升空，炸出一片又一片梦幻的光亮。
　　1349年最后一天的晚上，奥黛丽在社交意义上正式成年了。

　　——第二卷《无面人》第二百六十九章 辞旧迎新
ref_en:
Audrey exhaled slowly, blooming with an elegant and bright smile, and accompanied by her father and mother, she walked out of the lounge and into the ballroom. 
　　She walked all the way to the high platform at the front, and amidst the stunning gazes, she handed her hand, covered in white lace gloves reaching to the elbows, to the Queen. 
　　The Queen took her hand and walked to the edge of the high platform, facing all the guests. After a slight pause, the Queen smiled: 
　　"Although this is a dark period in Backlund's history, we still have a gem capable of illuminating the entire city. Her wisdom, her beauty, her character, and her etiquette are all impeccable. 
　　"Today, I officially introduce her to you. 
　　"Miss Audrey Hall." 
　　Bang! Bang! Bang! 
　　Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, fireworks rose into the sky, bursting into patches of dreamy light. 
　　On the night of the last day of 1349, Audrey was officially an adult in the social sense. 

　　——Volume 2: Faceless, Chapter 269: Ringing Out the Old and Ringing In the New

在霍纳奇斯山脉下有一处终年被银色雾气包裹的森林，里面住着各自各样的珍稀动物。其中，有一头叫做邓恩的麋鹿住在森林的最深处，它有着云朵般柔软的灰色皮毛和比橡木还要坚实的巨大鹿角，走路时的蹄声沉稳地如同森林的呼吸。它是这座森林的守护者，拥有洞察森林每一个角落的力量，但这份力量也伴随着诅咒——每年第一场雪落下的时候，它就会开始遗忘。

　　先是刚刚的对话，然后是昨天帮助过的动物，最后连自己的名字都如同飘落的雪花，落在地上了无痕迹。他只好把重要的事情都刻下来，做成木牌挂在鹿角上提醒自己。

　　有一只叫戴莉的知更鸟住在森林的东边，雾气更加浓郁的地方。它有着绯红色的羽毛，它可以用歌声编织出金色的旋律，为迷路的生灵指引方向。但这里藏着它的秘密：每编织一段完整的旋律，它就会掉落一根羽毛，掉落的羽毛不会再生长。
ref_en:
At the foot of the Hornacis Mountain Range, there is a forest covered in silver mist all year round, where all kinds of rare animals live. Among them, a moose named Dunn lives in the deepest part of the forest. It has gray fur as soft as clouds and huge antlers stronger than oak, and its hoofbeats when walking are as steady as the breathing of the forest. It is the guardian of this forest and has the power to gain insight into every corner of the forest, but this power is accompanied by a curse—when the first snow falls every year, it begins to forget.

　　First, the conversation just now, then the animals it helped yesterday, and finally even its own name falls on the ground like falling snowflakes, leaving no trace. It has to carve down important things and make them into wooden signs to hang on its antlers to remind itself.

　　A robin named Daly lives on the east side of the forest, where the mist is thicker. It has crimson feathers, and it can weave golden melodies with its singing to guide lost creatures. But there is a secret hidden here: every time it weaves a complete melody, it drops a feather, and the dropped feather will not grow again.

“呜————”银制的哨子被吹响，像夜莺温柔的呢喃、像夏夜温煦的风。
失控者停下攻击的动作，疯狂的眼眸中竟又凝起些许理智。
他看到了所有的遗憾被弥补、所有的不堪被抹去、所有的悲伤还未涌起。他看到了另一种幸福的结局。
做一场美梦吧，梦中的一切都还未堕落。
永眠于美梦吧，把今生的痛苦就此掩埋。
值夜者的猎魔子弹穿过了风，带走失控者的生命。异化后恐怖的身躯摇晃倒下，但是笑着的。
“愿女神庇佑你。”队友收起枪祈祷，又摸了摸肩上亲昵落下的小鸟，“这件封印物真是无害，毕竟，谁会把这些鸟儿当做负面作用呢？”
阿诺德拿出存放封印物的箱子，将夜莺银哨轻放了回去，妥帖地收在了身边。
他身形挺拔、眼神坚定、笑声爽朗，像极了一个故人。
“或许是因为，曾有一个温柔的灵魂栖息其中。”
ref_en:
"Woo—" The silver whistle was blown, like the gentle murmur of a nightingale, like the warm breeze of a summer night. 
The Out-of-Control Person stopped their attack, and a glimmer of reason actually condensed in their mad eyes. 
They saw all regrets being mended, all ugliness being wiped away, and all sadness yet to arise. They saw another happy ending. 
Have a beautiful dream; in the dream, nothing has fallen yet. 
Sleep forever in the beautiful dream, and bury the pain of this life here. 
The Nighthawk's Demon Hunter Bullet passed through the wind, taking away the life of the Out-of-Control Person. The terrifying, mutated body swayed and fell, but it was smiling. 
"May the Goddess protect you." The teammate put away the gun and prayed, then stroked the little bird that had affectionately landed on their shoulder. "This Sealed Artifact is truly harmless; after all, who would consider these birds as a negative effect?" 
Arnold took out the box for storing Sealed Artifacts and gently placed the Nightingale Silver Whistle back, tucking it away securely. 
His figure was upright, his eyes firm, and his laughter hearty, looking very much like an old friend. 
"Perhaps it is because a gentle soul once resided within it."

<Mark id="#159"> Steam engine </>, an invention known even to the poorest beggar today, came from Roselle's hands. From its inception, it was destined to push the world forward—in Roselle's own words—the original intention of inventing the steam engine was to liberate the productivity of this world. 
 Facts have proven that he succeeded, and compared to his many later achievements, this masterpiece was just the beginning. 
 ... (Large areas of gnawed marks) 
 Emperor Roselle is the greatest inventor recorded in history, and the favor of the "God of Craftsmanship" confirms this. Roselle was a loyal believer of the "God of Craftsmanship." During his reign, the Church of the "God of Craftsmanship" received the first public oracle since the Fifth Epoch—renaming the "God of Craftsmanship" to the "God of Steam and Machinery" and writing Roselle's inventions into the divine name.

source_cn: 感谢您几位的好意，真的。但最近雨季快到了，老约翰的风湿、丽莎家的双胞胎咳嗽都没好利索，南边镇上还有不少人说要来打疫苗……
ref_en: Thank you all for your kindness, really. But the rainy season is coming soon, Old John's rheumatism and the twins at Lisa's house haven't fully recovered from their coughs, and many people in the southern town say they are coming for vaccines...

source_cn: 我……我只是听说有家诊所药到病除。

source_cn: 我们相信，死亡不是终结，而是另一种安宁的开始。
ref_en: We believe that death is not the end, but the beginning of another kind of peace.

source_cn: 我就是黑夜中的魅影——侠盗黑皇帝！
ref_en: I am the phantom in the dark—the Phantom Thief Black Emperor!

source_cn: 或许您可以来一杯纯麦芽酿的朗齐，听说海盗也喜欢这种酒，虽然我没见过任何活海盗。
ref_en: Perhaps you could have a glass of pure malt-brewed Ranzhi. I've heard pirates like this drink too, though I've never seen any living pirates.

source_cn:
战区筛选积分仅在<Highlight>战区筛选期间</>的四方联赛中获取。筛选期间，俱乐部参与四方联赛并累计积分；筛选结束后，将按本赛区累计积分排名，<Highlight>前4名俱乐部晋级战略服</>。
四方联赛每场第一、二名进入胜者组，第三、四名进入败者组；第二场结束后，按比赛结果确定本轮第1至第8名。
战区筛选积分由<Highlight>单场名次积分</>与<Highlight>每轮最终排名积分</>累计组成：
<Highlight>单场名次积分：</>第1名30分，第2名15分，第3名10分，第4名5分。
<Highlight>第一轮最终排名积分：</>第1名60分，第2名50分，第3名45分，第4名40分，第5至第8名各10分。
<Highlight>第二轮最终排名积分：</>第1名200分，第2名100分，第3名70分，第4名50分，第5至第8名各15分。
<Highlight>同分排序规则：</>战区筛选排名优先按照<Highlight>战区筛选总积分</>由高到低排列。总积分相同时：第一轮或第二轮联赛结束后，按照俱乐部在本轮的<Highlight>最终排名</>排序，排名靠前者优先；四方联赛每轮第一场比赛结束后，本轮尚未产生最终排名，同分俱乐部暂不区分排名先后，当前展示顺序不代表本轮最终排名。
<Highlight>额外神选席位：</>战略服结算时，筛选时的赛区前三名俱乐部可额外获得神选席位：<Highlight>第1名10个，第2名5个，第3名5个</>。
ref_en:
Warzone screening points are only obtained during the Four-Way League <Highlight> during the warzone screening period </>. During the screening period, clubs participate in the Four-Way League and accumulate points; after the screening ends, they will be ranked according to the accumulated points in this region, and the <Highlight> top 4 clubs will be promoted to the strategic server </>. 
 The first and second place in each Four-Way League match enter the winner's bracket, and the third and fourth place enter the loser's bracket; after the second match, the 1st to 8th place for the round are determined based on the match results. 
 Warzone screening points are composed of the accumulation of <Highlight> single-match ranking points </> and <Highlight> final round ranking points </>: 
 <Highlight> Single-match ranking points: </> 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 15 points, 3rd place 10 points, 4th place 5 points. 
 <Highlight> First round final ranking points: </> 1st place 60 points, 2nd place 50 points, 3rd place 45 points, 4th place 40 points, 5th to 8th place 10 points each. 
 <Highlight> Second round final ranking points: </> 1st place 200 points, 2nd place 100 points, 3rd place 70 points, 4th place 50 points, 5th to 8th place 15 points each. 
 <Highlight> Tie-breaking rules: </> Warzone screening rankings are prioritized by <Highlight> total warzone screening points </> from high to low. When total points are the same: After the first or second round of the league, sort according to the club's <Highlight> final ranking </> in this round, with higher rankings taking precedence; after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League, the final ranking for this round has not yet been generated, so clubs with the same points are not distinguished by ranking, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking of this round. 
 <Highlight> Extra God-Chosen Seats: </> When the strategic server is settled, the top three clubs in the region during screening can obtain additional God-Chosen seats: <Highlight> 1st place 10, 2nd place 5, 3rd place 5 </>.

source_cn: 房租、药费、马车费……一起找上门的时候，你根本不知道先还哪一笔！
ref_en: Rent, medical bills, carriage fees... when they all come knocking at once, you have no idea which one to pay first!
Looking for someone? I'm a professional!

ref_en: Uncover the second contradiction in the case.

ref_en: Don't worry, dear Iron Needle, we are the best team on Iron Cross Street!

ref_en: Mr. Speer handed the written script to you, and you returned to the stage to continue the performance.

source_cn: 旧皮衣，煤油灯，还有一些面包和鹿肉。
ref_en: An old leather jacket, a kerosene lamp, and some bread and venison.

source_cn: 时任白银城首席的科林.伊利亚特在戴里克·伯格的帮助下举行祈祷仪式，俯视着灰雾俯视着灵界的那古老宫殿内，“愚者”回应了祈求，降下了恩赐。
ref_en: Colin Iliad, the then-Chief of the City of Silver, held a prayer ritual with the help of Derrick Berg. Inside that ancient palace overlooking the gray fog and the spirit world, 'The Fool' responded to the plea and bestowed a gift.

source_cn: 最受欢迎的是简妮斯，对于情感方面的……嗯，你懂的，她对这方面就很擅长，不管是男方还是女方。
ref_en: The most popular one is Janice. Regarding emotional matters... well, you know, she is very skilled in that area, whether it's for men or women.

ref_en: You exude the aroma of grilled fish, and nearby kittens cannot help but approach you.

ref_en: Young person, go walk around the stock exchange and see for yourself!

ref_en: I'm very sorry. If we had arrived earlier, this wouldn't have happened.

ref_en: Want to get paid? First sign up for the 'Dividend Bomb'—if you win, you split the money; if you lose, it's just your bad luck.

ref_en: I went to visit him lying in bed... but when he woke up, he forgot who I was... This must be the curse of the God of Armor...

source_cn: 我可能这辈子也见不到他啦，但他们总不能把小狗也关起来吧？
ref_en: I might never see him again in my life, but they can't lock up a puppy, right?

ref_en: Azik and I are here to attend a meeting. What kind of job did you find?

ref_en: I once prayed to Him for wealth, and with the good luck and courage He bestowed, I obtained that manor.

source_cn: 我觉得这位{{先生|女士}}的审美还不赖，如果你考虑加入廷根时尚协会的话……
ref_en: I think this {{sir|madam}}'s sense of style isn't bad. If you are considering joining the Tingen Fashion Association...

施法时获得1点<HighLight>太阳能量</>（<HighLight>烈阳</>状态下获得2点<HighLight>太阳能量</>）。
本技能可充能2次。

Charges at the designated enemy, continuously <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2"> knocking back </> them and dealing 5 instances of *d physical damage, knocking aside other enemies in the path and dealing *d physical damage; then delivers a finishing strike with the halberd, dealing *d area physical damage, <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2"> knocking back </> the target and applying *f seconds of mul(*d**,*d) <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="20"> Healing Reduction </> and *f seconds of <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="9"> Stagnation </>. You gain <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="11"> Super Armor </> during the charge. When the charge target has Super Armor, you will stop charging, deal *d physical damage to them, and apply the additional effect of the finishing strike. 
 Gain 1 point of <HighLight> Solar Energy </> when casting (gain 2 points of <HighLight> Solar Energy </> in the <HighLight> Blazing Sun </> state). 
 This skill can be charged 2 times. 

<FaintYellow> Solar Energy </>: Hold up to 5 points. Obtain Solar Energy to unlock and strengthen <HighLight> Punishment </> and <HighLight> Unshadowed Spear </>.
